starters: CJ McCollum, Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Dyson Daniels, Jalen Johnson, Onyeka Okongwu
bench: Luguentz Dort (6th), Aaron Wiggins (7th), Jock Landale (backup C), Kingston Flemings (backup PG), Asa Newell (10th); Corey Kispert and Dorian Finney-Smith on the fringe
notes: Josh Lloyd expects all five starters to play 30+ minutes. If Jalen Johnson sits, his usage scatters to McCollum, Alexander-Walker and possibly Flemings. If Okongwu sits, Landale starts and plays 30+ minutes. The team has 14 back-to-backs.

starters: Fred VanVleet, Amen Thompson, Kevin Durant, Jabari Smith Jr., Alperen Sengun
bench: Marcus Smart (6th), Tari Eason (7th, ~25 min), Steven Adams (backup C), Reed Sheppard (backup PG, ~24-26 min), Bogdan Bogdanovic (10th)
backup_c: Steven Adams, then Clint Capela when Adams rests
notes: Udoka plays his starters heavy minutes and is defense-first. Added guard depth means Amen Thompson plays less point guard. If VanVleet sits, Smart could start. If Durant or Jabari Smith sits, Eason could reach about 32 minutes. The team has 14 back-to-backs.

starters: Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves, Quentin Grimes, Matisse Thybulle, Walker Kessler
bench: Sandro Mamukelashvili (6th), Collin Sexton (7th), Ziaire Williams, Jake LaRavia, Jarred Vanderbilt
backup_c: Sandro Mamukelashvili (Kevon Looney is the third option)
notes: The fifth starter spot is uncertain and may rotate between Thybulle, LaRavia and Williams. If Luka or Reaves sits, Grimes is the main beneficiary. If Kessler sits, Mamukelashvili plays 30+ minutes. The Lakers have the second-most back-to-backs in the league.

starters: Anthony Edwards, LaMelo Ball, Jaden McDaniels, Jonathan Kuminga, Rudy Gobert (projected)
bench: Ayo Dosunmu (bench creator, ~29 min), Joan Beringer (backup C, ~16 min), Josh Green (might start)
notes: Kuminga signed and is expected to start. Naz Reid and Julius Randle are gone. If Gobert sits, Beringer is the backup center to watch. Beringer projects at about 18 minutes behind Gobert.

starters: Coby White (PG), Kon Knueppel, Brandon Miller, Naz Reid (PF) — partial
bench: Dennis Schroder, Grayson Allen
notes: LaMelo Ball and Miles Bridges are gone. Josh Lloyd is adamant Schroder will not start over Coby White. Knueppel's usage should rise from about 22% to about 25%.

starters: Tyrese Maxey, Jaylen Brown, LeBron James, Joel Embiid — partial
bench: VJ Edgecombe (usage may fall below 20%)
notes: Jaylen Brown, LeBron James, Maxey and Embiid together cannot all keep last year's usage, so expect pullbacks. Embiid is expected to miss time.

starters: Jayson Tatum, Paul George — partial

bench: Scoot Henderson

bench: Danny Wolf, Noah Clowney
notes: Brooklyn does not own its pick (it goes to Houston), so Josh Lloyd flags tanking risk and possible late-season rest for veterans.

bench: Collin Murray-Boyles
notes: Kawhi arrived by trade from the Clippers. Sandro Mamukelashvili is gone, which opens backup center minutes for Murray-Boyles.

starters: Darius Garland (PG), Brandon Ingram (assumed), Max Strus (probably), Brook Lopez (C) — partial
bench: Rui Hachimura, Kris Dunn, Bradley Beal
notes: Kawhi is gone. Josh Lloyd expects the Clippers to be bad, with Ingram possibly near 30% usage. Jordan Miller is out until after the All-Star break. The NBA took five first-round picks from the Clippers and fined Steve Ballmer $30 million after the Kawhi investigation; the Clippers say they will challenge it.
